title: Office of Sustainability at AASHE 2026 Conference
description: Dr. Kyungmin Lee participated in the AASHE Conference, connecting with the higher education sustainability community and advancing campus sustainability assessment work.
body: The Office of Sustainability participated in the 2026 AASHE Conference in Baltimore, Maryland, from October 4-6, to connect with the higher education sustainability community and strengthen Adelphi University's campus sustainability work.

The conference provided opportunities to learn from peer institutions, explore approaches to sustainability assessment and reporting, and identify strategies that can support future campus initiatives.

title: SAGE Lab launches at Adelphi University
description: The Sustainability Analytics, Governance & Environment Lab begins interdisciplinary research at the intersection of energy, environment, policy, sustainability, and data science.
body: The Sustainability Analytics, Governance & Environment Lab launched at Adelphi University in Fall 2026.
SAGE brings together environmental research, policy analysis, sustainability, and data science to develop evidence that can inform public decisions.

title: Adelphi University Welcomes New Faculty for 2026–2027
description: Adelphi University welcomes Dr. Kyungmin Lee as an assistant professor in Environmental Studies and Sciences and sustainability director.
body: Adelphi University welcomed its new faculty for the 2026–2027 academic year, including Dr. Kyungmin Lee, assistant professor in the Department of Environmental Studies and Sciences and sustainability director.

Dr. Lee's research spans energy policy, climate policy, urban sustainability, and community development using qualitative and quantitative methods. Her recent work applies artificial intelligence to large-scale image analysis to understand public responses to environmental issues.
Dr. Lee holds a doctoral degree in energy and environmental policy, a master's degree in environmental studies, and a bachelor's degree in economics.
